name: Kurokami Kyonyuu Iinchou to Chikan Saiban
original_name: 黒髪巨乳委員長と痴漢裁判
source:
Molesters, classmates, doctors... even in the house of law she is humiliated. 
There be no end to the violation of this quiet and timid black haired, big tittied girl.

A few months have passed since her ordeal began...
Yuri receives a call from the police. They want her to act as bait to 
lure the molesters so they can be put on trial in one fell swoop but...
'bait' can only mean one thing...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123458.html]DLsite English[/url]]
